cyc_matrix.scope: Defines a finite complex matrix with entry equal to the input-column weight when the row is the image of that column under the given bijection, and zero otherwise. The definition allows arbitrary complex weights. Unit-modulus assumptions, cycle invariants and inverse measurement claims enter in the questions.

cyc_product.scope: Proves the exact two-factor multiplication law for finite complex weighted permutations. The second factor acts first, and the later weight is evaluated on the intermediate label. Iteration, fixed-reference calibration, trace recovery and ambiguity constructions are authored deductions.

cyc_seq.scope: Defines chronological composition for two primitive programs with certified monomial semantics, transports the later phase through the earlier permutation, and proves the resulting exact evaluation. The general finite-label multiplication theorem is a separate anchor. This program record does not establish the proposed circuit-rewrite criterion.

cyc_control.scope: Defines the basis action of a controlled NOT by testing the control bit and applying a target flip only when the control is nonzero. The two-bit phase comparison assumes distinct control and target wires.

cyc_cx.scope: Identifies the evaluation of a primitive controlled NOT on distinct wires with its basis permutation carrying weight one on every column.

cyc_gate_phase.scope: Identifies the lifted single-wire phase gate of angle theta with the identity basis permutation and input weight one on bit zero or exp(i theta) on bit one. The gate-order test and the two-bit diagnostic are deductions.
